name: d3code
description: Agentic terminal coding environment for Rocket D3.

scripts.build: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build:ide && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ide.json
scripts.build:app: npm run build:ide && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ide.json
scripts.test: PYTHONPATH=python python3 -m unittest discover -s python/tests && TEST_D3CODE_HOME="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/d3code-node-test-home"; TEST_PATH=$(printf '%s' "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v "^$HOME/.local/bin$" | paste -sd ':' -); rm -rf "$TEST_D3CODE_HOME"; PATH="$TEST_PATH" D3CODE_HOME="$TEST_D3CODE_HOME" npm run build && PATH="$TEST_PATH" D3CODE_HOME="$TEST_D3CODE_HOME" node --test dist/**/*.test.js
scripts.regression: npm test && node dist/src/cli.js doctor && node dist/src/cli.js install-proof && node dist/src/cli.js manual-scope reference/d3_reference_manual_10.3.4_5-28-2026.pdf && node dist/src/cli.js manual-scope reference/d3_user_guide_version_10_3_4_2026-05-28-20-56-09.pdf && node dist/src/cli.js product-audit --with-acceptance --allow-incomplete && node dist/src/cli.js acceptance
